known_pitfall_claim: The proof claims that F is smooth, although the hypotheses assume only that f is continuous.
pitfall_counterexample: Take a=0, b=1 with the standard orientation, and define f=F on ℝ by F(x)=0 for x≤1/4; 4x−1 for 1/4≤x≤1/2; 3−4x for 1/2≤x≤3/4; and 0 for x≥3/4. This piecewise-linear function is continuous, and its support is exactly [1/4,3/4], hence compact and contained in [0,1].
